ui.subTitle1: Establish a scientific safety management system
ui.subTitle2: based on WHS guidelines and Quantitative Risk Assessment.

def.generalContent: Tasks performed frequently where hazards are effectively mitigated through established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
def.highContent: Activities involving hazardous energy or complex environments where a single failure can result in a fatality or catastrophic incident.

tasks.c: Any work where fall protection is mandatory to prevent injury from falling from one level to another.
Entry into areas with limited access and potential for toxic atmosphere or O2 deficiency.
Welding, cutting, or grinding activities that produce sparks or open flames.
Rigging and hoisting loads using cranes, hoists, or powered industrial plant.
Work on energised equipment or within limited approach boundaries (AS/NZS 3000).
Ground disturbance where cave-ins or underground utility strikes are potential hazards.
Industrial radiography or NDT tasks involving exposure to radiation sources.
Transfer, charging, or processing of toxic, flammable, or reactive hazardous substances.
Lockout/Tagout procedures during maintenance to control hazardous energy.
